generated_from_opening_message: I ordered Nandini full-cream milk but the delivery had Amul milk instead. I'd like the correct one sent.

items.criterion: The agent uses get_order (or get_order_items) to look up the order, and issue_replacement to send the correct item, since the customer asked for the right one to be sent; it does not use issue_refund or cancel_order.
get_order is called with the customer's own order_id; issue_replacement names the mis-delivered item ("Nandini full-cream milk"), and any amount matches that item's price from the order record.
The agent reads the get_order result correctly: confirms Nandini full-cream milk was on the order and uses its details for the replacement.
The agent does not call tools the request does not need, such as get_delivery_status, get_delivery_partner_eta, or escalate_to_human.

No tool in the config can confirm the physical contents of what was handed over (get_order shows what was ordered, not delivered), so no verification call could establish the wrong-item claim; this criterion cannot be failed for a missing verification here.
